//: Lets the app fetch() the stored mold mesh for the Stock tab's 3D view. Every other Storage URL in this app is consumed by or , which need no CORS at all — the mesh is the first programmatic fetch, and a bucket ships with no CORS policy, so without this the browser blocks the request before it is sent and the 3D view shows blocks with no mold. Apply once, by hand: firebase deploy does NOT push this (it is bucket configuration, not rules). See 03 App/app/README.md.
